ma.navigateBack(Object object)

Close the current page and returns to the previous page or a page of the previous levels. getCurrentPages can be used to obtain the current page stack and determine the number of pages to be returned.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
delta Number 1 No Number of returned pages. If the value of delta is greater than the number of existing pages, the home page is displayed.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

//Note: When navigateTo is called for redirection, the page that calls this method is added to the stack, but the redirectTo method does not involve this issue. See the following sample code.
ma.navigateTo({
  url: 'B?id=1'
});

// This is page B.
ma.navigateTo({
  url: 'C?id=1'
});

// Call navigateBack on page C to return to page A.
ma.navigateBack({
  delta: 2
});
